reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to USD 200m (ca. EUR 173m) to National Bank of Egypt ("NBE") comprising of a committed tranche of up to USD 100m (ca. EUR 87m) for the Bank's own account, to be committed at signing and an uncommitted tranche of up to USD 100m (ca. EUR 87m) to be committed at a later stage. The Bank will endeavour to mobilise commercial lenders under its A/B loan structure on a best efforts basis. The proceeds of the loan will be used by NBE and its leasing microfinance subsidiaries (Al Ahly Leasing and Al Ahly Tamkeen Microfinance) for on-lending to local private MSMEs and MSMEs+ with a focus on youth, women and regional MSMEs. Half of the proceeds are expected to be on-lent to regions outside of Cairo and Alexandria. Moreover, half of the total funding will be specifically channelled to women led and/or owned and young entrepreneurs led and/or owned enterprises, particularly underserved in Egypt.
